excluded_forms.reason: Different product; outside the raw groundnut scope

notes: Candidate 6-digit HS codes must be confirmed against the importing country's tariff schedule before company-level collection.

target_markets.reason: Largest buyer of Indian groundnuts; imports ~$419M in 2024 and growing; India supplies ~68%.
India supplies almost all of its imports (~96% in 2023). India's exports fell from $215M (2023) to $125M (2024); 2024 imports not yet reported.
Second-largest importer worldwide (~$624M in 2024) and the EU's trading hub; India's share is only ~1-2%. EU aflatoxin limits are strict.
